summary: 顺帝子，二岁即位，梁太后临朝；次年崩，梁冀立质帝。
summary_en: Son of Emperor Shun, enthroned at two under the Liang regency; he died the next year and Liang Ji raised Emperor Zhi.

bio_md:
# 汉冲帝 · 主要事迹

刘炳是[[e-han-shun|顺帝]]之子，建康元年顺帝崩，年二岁的刘炳即位，梁太后临朝，梁冀秉政——东汉的幼主政治至此进入极端形态：皇帝小到连「系年」都嫌勉强。

冲帝在位约五个月。永嘉元年，九江等地盗贼蜂起，朝廷所面临的已是一个民变四起的帝国，而主政的梁氏一门正忙于巩固自己的权势。正月，冲帝崩于玉堂前殿，在位不足周岁，葬怀陵。梁太后与梁冀旋定策迎立渤海孝王之子刘缵，是为[[e-han-zhi|质帝]]。

冲帝之世没有留下任何属于他自己的政策或意志，但他并非没有自己的年号——即位次年正月初一改元永嘉，数日而崩，这个年号短得只够写进纪年，其治皆梁氏所为。他存在的意义，在于证明东汉皇权已经空洞到可以由一个婴儿来填充——而下一个被填充进来的[[e-han-zhi|八岁质帝]]，将用一句「跋扈将军」结束自己，也揭开桓灵之世的大幕。

> 参考：点校本《后汉书》卷006《孝冲帝纪》、《梁冀传》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Bing was the son of

. When Shun died in the first Jiankang year, the two-year-old Bing took the throne, with Empress Dowager Liang in the regency and Liang Ji in power — Eastern Han's child-emperor politics now reaching its extreme form, a sovereign too small even for the courtesy of dating.

He reigned about five months. In the first Yongjia year bandits rose in force at Jiujiang and elsewhere: the court faced an empire of spreading revolt, while the Liang house was busy consolidating its own position. In the first month of the year he died in the front hall of the Yutang Palace, having reigned under a year, and was buried at Huailing. Empress Dowager Liang and Liang Ji then chose Liu Zuan, son of the filial king of Bohai, as

.

No policy, no will, not even a settled era-name system of his own belongs to Chong's reign (Yongjia was the era adopted after Jiankang, its government all Liang's doing). His significance is that the Han throne had grown empty enough to be filled by an infant — and the next infant to be filled in, the eight-year-old

, would end himself with the phrase "arrogant general," opening the curtain on the Huan-Ling age.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Hou Hanshu*, ch. 6 (Benji of Emperor Chong) and the biography of Liang Ji; Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
